methodologyNotes: Re-verified against each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-18 (helium10.com/pricing, junglescout.com/pricing/catalyst-plans, amzscout.net, sellerapp.com/pricing.html, datadive.tools/pricing, smartscout.com/pricing) and corroborated via WebSearch/third-party reviews (revenuegeeks.com). Keepa.com returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches; Keepa pricing corroborated via revenuegeeks.com/keepa-pricing — natively EUR (€19/mo, €189/yr), USD figures approximate. Largest correction: Jungle Scout's annual prices in the draft were fabricated (e.g. Starter annual $208.80/$17.40-mo) — the official catalyst page shows Starter $348/yr, Growth Accelerator $588/yr, Brand Owner+CI $1,548/yr. Helium 10 Free plan retained (page title lists Free; confirmed still offered via search) though the main pricing table renders only Platinum/Diamond/Enterprise. Viral Launch excluded (service shut down). All enterprise/custom tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
